kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أقتنع (form VIII)
# أَقْتَنِعُ (ʔaqtaniʕu) /ʔaq.ta.ni.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَنَعَ (iqtanaʕa)
# أَقْتَنِعَ (ʔaqtaniʕa) /ʔaq.ta.ni.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَنَعَ (iqtanaʕa)
# أَقْتَنِعْ (ʔaqtaniʕ) /ʔaq.ta.niʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِقْتَنَعَ (iqtanaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
